title: Team Spirit: Evaluating Group Performance Efficiency
thumbnail_alt: Team Spirit experiment screenshot showing paddle game
summary: Applying workload capacity analysis to human team performance reveals that teamwork introduces measurable efficiency costs — teams score more than individuals, but not as much more as two independently-working people would. Collaboration is more efficient than competition, and both impose cognitive load costs on individual members. Subsequent work extends this paradigm to AI teammates and real-time cognitive modelling.
